## Abstract

Cross-domain transfer is a defining property of foundation models, yet whether such transfer is symmetric across domains remains unknown. Prior work has reported a striking transfer from natural language to biological sequences: language models fine-tuned only on English structural tasks acquire zero-shot protein-homology discrimination. Here we ask the converse and general question is structural transfer between language and biology directional and answer it systematically. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
